extracted.intended_audience: journalists worldwide; prospective Hostwriter members and supporters
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and requirements for journalists who want to join and use the Hostwriter cross-border collaboration network, and for supporters/donors interested in the organisation's mission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Get & Give Advice
rubrics_metrics.description: Use the Hostwriter network to find and share advice on topics of interest with journalists all over the world.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Leverage the community to ask questions and offer expertise; the site positions this as a core member activity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Start collaborating
rubrics_metrics.description: Search Hostwriter to find colleagues to work with - whether in your hometown or on the other side of the planet.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the HostWIRE chatroom to find calls for collaboration; the platform supports searching for collaborators globally.

rubrics_metrics.name: Find accommodation
rubrics_metrics.description: Over half of our members also offer their couch. Stay with a Hostwriter for your next research trip or journalism conference.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Members can use the network to request temporary local accommodation from other members when traveling.

rubrics_metrics.name: Professional verification via work samples
rubrics_metrics.description: All Hostwriter members provide work samples by way of professional verification.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Membership involves submitting work samples so other members can verify professional status; membership is free of charge.

rubrics_metrics.name: Membership is free
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Hostwriter's services are free for journalists worldwide; this is an explicit eligibility/cost criterion for joining.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support journalists at all career levels
rubrics_metrics.description: We support journalists at all career levels to raise the quality of media coverage by providing local contacts around the globe.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Hostwriter explicitly targets early-career through experienced journalists and promotes cross-border contact provision as a method to improve coverage quality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project focus: networking, training, and shifting power dynamics
rubrics_metrics.description: Hostwriter implements projects that align with our mission—powering the future of collaborative journalism. Our projects focus on networking, training, and shifting power dynamics in the field.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Projects are meant to use cross-border journalism to overcome national bias and prejudice and to contribute to better informed, more accountable and democratic societies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unbias the News — support for journalists facing structural barriers
rubrics_metrics.description: Unbias the News creates a space for journalists experiencing structural barriers in the field, working towards a more equitable and inclusive world of journalism.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This project targets journalists who face structural obstacles and is framed as part of Hostwriter's mission to shift power dynamics and increase inclusivity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Donate to support free services
rubrics_metrics.description: Hostwriter is a non-profit organization. Our services are free for journalists worldwide, and with independent media under attack your donation really counts!
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Donations are solicited to sustain free services and the organisation's mission; supporters are invited to 'Help power the future of collaborative journalism.'
